text: Cutworm (ដង្កូវកាត់ដើម): a fairly large, elongated, greenish-colored caterpillar common in radish fields. Its moth lays eggs on weeds/grass on the soil surface before the crop is planted. After the crop germinates and reaches the seedling stage, the larvae hatch and become active, cutting through seedling stems as their food source at night — causing significant plant loss in the field if not managed.
